description:
I’m Atharv, an Engineering Admission Counsellor dedicated to helping students navigate engineering admissions with clarity and confidence.

I focus on understanding each student’s profile—their exam performance, interests, and career expectations—and then guiding them toward suitable colleges and branches. I pay special attention to realistic cutoffs, option strategy, and counselling timelines, so students avoid common mistakes during CAP rounds.

I work in collaboration with Aditya (COEP) to ensure students receive transparent, practical, and up-to-date guidance, helping them make well-informed admission decisions across Maharashtra.
